description:
Export the project's types as runnable SQL DDL (CREATE TABLE statements) for PostgreSQL / SQLite.

Identifiers are double-quoted; column types come from the Json Schema Mixin (number -> NUMERIC, integer -> INTEGER, boolean -> BOOLEAN, string date/date-time -> DATE/TIMESTAMP, else VARCHAR); required -> NOT NULL; every table gets a PRIMARY KEY (the element marked key, else a generated "id" VARCHAR(36)); a Controlled List -> CHECK (col IN (...)); a Range Includes to a Type -> a foreign key (on the child table for an array, e.g. "customer_id" on "Order"); referenced tables come first.

nodeIds.description: Optional type node ids to export; omit to export all types (optionally scoped to a space).

name: export_sql
title: Export SQL
